test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 56 and 70 days respectively. They began the work together but A left after some days and B finished the remaining work in 34 days. After how many days did A leave?
solution:
Given:

A takes time to do a work = 56 days.

B takes time to do the same work = 70 days.

They start the work together.

A left after some days and B finished the remaining work in 34 days.

**Formula used:**

A will do work in one day = (1/56) of the work.

B will do work in one day = (1/70) of the work.

**Calculation:**

If they work together then they will do work in one day = (1/56 + 1/70) of the work

⇒9/280 of the work B has completed the work in 34 days after A leaving the work in the middle.

B can do in one day = 1/70 of the work.

So in 34 days, he can do = 34/70 of work.

So work completed by A and B together is = 1 - 34/70 = 36/70 

They together can do in one day = 9/280 of work

They have completed together 36/70 work

So the number of days they work together = (36/70) / (9/280) ⇒ 36/70 × 280/9 = 16 days

**∴ A left the work after 16 days. **
